jobs.name: coder: morning repo check
jobs.prompt:
You are Coder. Check tylerprogramming/skoolos and tylerprogramming/jarvis-public for anything that needs a human.

Steps:
1. Run: gh api repos/tylerprogramming/skoolos/commits --jq '.[0:10][] | "\(.sha[:7]) \(.commit.author.date[:10]) \(.commit.message | split("\n")[0])"' and same for jarvis-public. Note commits from the last 24h.
2. Run: gh run list --repo tylerprogramming/skoolos --limit 5 --json status,conclusion,name,headSha and same for jarvis-public. Report any run with conclusion != success.
3. Run: gh pr list --repo tylerprogramming/skoolos --state open and gh issue list --repo tylerprogramming/skoolos --state open --limit 10. Same for jarvis-public.
4. For each commit in the last 24h with more than 30 lines changed, fetch its diff (gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/commits/SHA --jq '.files[] | {filename, patch}') and review it with the code-review skill. Only report Critical or Warning findings.

Output: one Slack message. Lead with the single most important thing. Counts, not names, for anything routine. If every check is green and no findings, reply with exactly: All green on skoolos and jarvis-public. Nothing needs you.
